description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," illustrates the proportional contribution of various data sources to a training dataset. The chart is composed of multiple colored slices, each representing a different source and its corresponding percentage. The largest slice, colored blue, corresponds to NQ, which accounts for 31.3% of the total. The second largest is FEVER, shown in a teal color, contributing 16.1%. Other significant contributors include SNLI (15.4%, brownish-orange), VITAMINC (13.0%, light teal), and MULTINLI (11.3%, reddish-brown). Smaller sources include SCIFACT (0.1%, very light green), ENTFA (1.8%, yellow-green), FACTCC (2.6%, light green), ANLI (4.6%, orange), SCITAIL (1.2%, dark green), PUBHEALTH (0.5%, dark red), and MULTIFC (0.5%, dark blue). Each slice is labeled with its source name and percentage, with lines connecting the labels to their respective segments. The slices are arranged around the circle in a clockwise direction, with the largest segment positioned at the top right.
